questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body you use to see?
explanation: Eye is the correct spelling - E-Y-E. The eye is the organ of sight.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body you use to smell?
explanation: Nose is the correct spelling - N-O-S-E. The nose is the organ of smell.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body you use to hear?
explanation: Ear is the correct spelling - E-A-R. The ear is the organ of hearing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body at the end of your arm?
explanation: Hand is the correct spelling - H-A-N-D. The hand has fingers and is used to grip things.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body you walk on?
explanation: Foot is the correct spelling - F-O-O-T. The foot has toes. It has double O.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body that connects the head to the body?
explanation: Neck is the correct spelling - N-E-C-K. The neck connects the head to the rest of the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body where your stomach is?
explanation: Belly is the correct spelling - B-E-L-L-Y. The belly contains the stomach. It ends with LLY.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the digit on your hand?
explanation: Finger is the correct spelling - F-I-N-G-E-R. Fingers are the five digits on each hand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part above your neck?
explanation: Head is the correct spelling - H-E-A-D. The head sits on top of the neck.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the digit on your foot?
explanation: Toe is the correct spelling - T-O-E. Toes are the digits on the foot. Just 3 letters.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint in the middle of your leg?
explanation: Knee is the correct spelling - K-N-E-E. The knee is the joint in the middle of the leg. The K is silent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint in the middle of your arm?
explanation: Elbow is the correct spelling - E-L-B-O-W. The elbow is the joint that bends your arm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the front part of your leg below the knee?
explanation: Shin is the correct spelling - S-H-I-N. The shin is the front part of the lower leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the leg at the back below the knee?
explanation: Calf is the correct spelling - C-A-L-F. The calf is the muscular back part of the lower leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the bony structure that protects the brain?
explanation: Skull is the correct spelling - S-K-U-L-L. The skull is the bony structure of the head. It ends with double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the bony cage that protects the heart and lungs?
explanation: Ribcage is the correct spelling - R-I-B-C-A-G-E. The ribcage is formed by the ribs and protects vital organs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the hard white covering on teeth?
explanation: Enamel is the correct spelling - E-N-A-M-E-L. Enamel is the hard outer coating of a tooth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that processes food after the stomach?
explanation: Intestine is the correct spelling - I-N-T-E-S-T-I-N-E. The intestine absorbs nutrients from food.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the hollow organ that stores urine?
explanation: Bladder is the correct spelling - B-L-A-D-D-E-R. The bladder stores urine before it leaves the body. It has double D.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the body containing the digestive organs?
explanation: Abdomen is the correct spelling - A-B-D-O-M-E-N. The abdomen is the belly area containing digestive organs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the tiny part of the eye that controls light entry?
explanation: Pupil is the correct spelling - P-U-P-I-L. The pupil is the dark centre of the eye that controls light.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the coloured ring around the pupil?
explanation: Iris is the correct spelling - I-R-I-S. The iris is the coloured part of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the upper arm bone?
explanation: Humerus is the correct spelling - H-U-M-E-R-U-S. The humerus is the long bone in the upper arm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the soft lower part of the outer ear?
explanation: Earlobe is the correct spelling - E-A-R-L-O-B-E. The earlobe is the soft fleshy part at the bottom of the ear.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the pair of organs used for breathing?
explanation: Lungs is the correct spelling - L-U-N-G-S. Lungs take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the transparent protective front surface of the eye?
explanation: Cornea is the correct spelling - C-O-R-N-E-A. The cornea is the clear dome-shaped front of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the longest bone in the human body?
explanation: Femur is the correct spelling - F-E-M-U-R. The femur is the thigh bone, the longest in the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that controls the whole nervous system?
explanation: Brain is the correct spelling - B-R-A-I-N. The brain is the control centre of the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the muscle that pumps blood around the body?
explanation: Heart is the correct spelling - H-E-A-R-T. The heart pumps blood. It ends with E-A-R-T.

questionText: One of these body parts is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Earlob is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is earlobe - E-A-R-L-O-B-E. Pupil, iris, and heart are correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that filters blood and produces bile?
explanation: Liver is the correct spelling - L-I-V-E-R. The liver filters blood and produces bile.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organs that filter waste products from blood?
explanation: Kidneys is the correct spelling - K-I-D-N-E-Y-S. The kidneys filter blood and produce urine.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the strong fibrous tissue that connects bones at joints?
explanation: Ligament is the correct spelling - L-I-G-A-M-E-N-T. Ligaments connect bones together.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the fibrous tissue that connects muscle to bone?
explanation: Tendon is the correct spelling - T-E-N-D-O-N. Tendons attach muscles to bones.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the smooth, rubbery tissue that cushions joints?
explanation: Cartilage is the correct spelling - C-A-R-T-I-L-A-G-E. Cartilage reduces friction at joints.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the largest organ of the human body?
explanation: Skin is the correct spelling - S-K-I-N. The skin is the largest organ, protecting the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the muscular tube that carries food from mouth to stomach?
explanation: Esophagus is the correct spelling - E-S-O-P-H-A-G-U-S. The esophagus connects the throat to the stomach.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the gland in the brain that controls growth hormones?
explanation: Pituitary is the correct spelling - P-I-T-U-I-T-A-R-Y. The pituitary gland controls growth hormones.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the brain at the back that controls balance?
explanation: Cerebellum is the correct spelling - C-E-R-E-B-E-L-L-U-M. The cerebellum controls balance. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye?
explanation: Retina is the correct spelling - R-E-T-I-N-A. The retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the tube carrying air from the throat to the lungs?
explanation: Trachea is the correct spelling - T-R-A-C-H-E-A. The trachea is the windpipe that carries air to the lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that stores and concentrates bile?
explanation: Gallbladder is the correct spelling - G-A-L-L-B-L-A-D-D-E-R. The gallbladder stores bile. It has double L and double D.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the brain responsible for higher thinking?
explanation: Cerebrum is the correct spelling - C-E-R-E-B-R-U-M. The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the membrane surrounding the lungs?
explanation: Pleura is the correct spelling - P-L-E-U-R-A. The pleura is the double membrane surrounding the lungs.

questionText: One of these Olympiad body part words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Cerebelum is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is cerebellum - C-E-R-E-B-E-L-L-U-M. It needs double L. Liver, ligament, and tendon are correct.

questionText: One of these body part words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Pitutary is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is pituitary - P-I-T-U-I-T-A-R-Y. The UI combination in the middle is often missed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the collarbone connecting shoulder to chest?
explanation: Clavicle is the correct spelling - C-L-A-V-I-C-L-E. The clavicle is the collarbone connecting the shoulder to the sternum.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the breastbone in the centre of the chest?
explanation: Sternum is the correct spelling - S-T-E-R-N-U-M. The sternum is the flat bone in the centre of the chest.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the shinbone, the larger bone in the lower leg?
explanation: Tibia is the correct spelling - T-I-B-I-A. The tibia is the larger of the two bones in the lower leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the hollow cavity in bones that produces blood cells?
explanation: Marrow is the correct spelling - M-A-R-R-O-W. Bone marrow produces red and white blood cells. It has double R.
